``` {r}
library(readr)

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(reactable)
library(gt)
library(leaflet)

library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

library(crosstalk)
```


```{r}
sf_data <- read_rds("clean_data/registrations_sf_summary.rds") |>
    select(
        NAME,
        active_pct_2026, active_pct_2015, active_diff,
        two_party_active_pct_2026, two_party_active_pct_2015, two_party_active_diff,
        rep_active_pct_2026, rep_active_pct_2015, rep_active_diff,
        dem_active_pct_2026, dem_active_pct_2015, dem_active_diff
    ) |>
  arrange(desc(active_pct_2026))

long_data <- read_rds("clean_data/registrations_long.rds")

long_sf_data <- read_rds("clean_data/registrations_sf_summary_long.rds")

# Lookup: raw variable name -> human-readable label
# Covers sf_data column names
var_labels <- tribble(
    ~name,                        ~label,
    # Geography
    "NAME",                       "County",
    # Summary columns (sf_data / long_sf_data)
    "active_pct_2026",            "Active % (Jan 2026)",
    "active_pct_2015",            "Active % (Jan 2015)",
    "active_diff",                "Active % Change (2015-2026)",
    "two_party_active_pct_2026",  "Two-Party Active % (Jan 2026)",
    "two_party_active_pct_2015",  "Two-Party Active % (Jan 2015)",
    "two_party_active_diff",      "Two-Party Active % Change (2015-2026)",
    "rep_active_pct_2026",        "Republican Active % (Jan 2026)",
    "rep_active_pct_2015",        "Republican Active % (Jan 2015)",
    "rep_active_diff",            "Republican Active % Change (2015-2026)",
    "dem_active_pct_2026",        "Democratic Active % (Jan 2026)",
    "dem_active_pct_2015",        "Democratic Active % (Jan 2015)",
    "dem_active_diff",            "Democratic Active % Change (2015-2026)",
    "no_party_active_pct_2026",   "No-Party Active % (Jan 2026)",
    "no_party_active_pct_2015",   "No-Party Active % (Jan 2015)",
    "no_party_active_diff",       "No-Party Active % Change (2015-2026)",
    "lib_active_pct_2026",        "Libertarian Active % (Jan 2026)",
    "lib_active_pct_2015",        "Libertarian Active % (Jan 2015)",
    # Base variable names (long_data$name)
    "active_pct",                 "Active %",
    "inactive_pct",               "Inactive %",
    "two_party_active_pct",       "Two-Party Active %",
    "rep_active_pct",             "Republican Active %",
    "dem_active_pct",             "Democratic Active %",
    "no_party_active_pct",        "No-Party Active %",
    "lib_active_pct",             "Libertarian Active %",
    "reg_pct",                    "Registration %",
    "two_party_reg_pct",          "Two-Party Registration %",
    "rep_reg_pct",                "Republican Registration %",
    "dem_reg_pct",                "Democratic Registration %"
)

# Rename sf_data columns using the lookup
sf_rename_vec <- setNames(
    (var_labels |> filter(name %in% names(sf_data)))$name,
    (var_labels |> filter(name %in% names(sf_data)))$label
)
sf_data <- sf_data |> rename(all_of(sf_rename_vec))

shared_long_data <- SharedData$new(long_data)

```

```{r}
gt(
    sf_data |>
      st_drop_geometry()
) |>
    fmt_percent(contains("active"), decimals = 1) |>
    opt_interactive(
        page_size_default = 10,
        page_size_values = c(10, 25, 50, 99),
        use_page_size_select = TRUE,
        use_search = TRUE
    )

```


```{r}
make_leaflet_map <- function(data, col, legend_title) {
    values <- data[[col]]
    pal <- colorNumeric("viridis", domain = values)
    labels <- paste0("<b>", data$County, "</b><br>", col, ": ", round(values * 100, 1), "%")

    leaflet(data) |>
        addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
        addPolygons(
            fillColor = pal(values),
            fillOpacity = 0.7,
            color = "black",
            weight = 1,
            opacity = 1,
            label = lapply(labels, htmltools::HTML),
            popup = lapply(labels, htmltools::HTML),
            highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
                weight = 3, color = "#666",
                fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE
            )
        ) |>
        addLegend(
            pal = pal,
            values = values,
            opacity = 0.85,
            title = htmltools::HTML(legend_title),
            labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%", transform = function(x) round(x * 100, 1)),
            position = "bottomright"
        )
}
```


#### Active Voter Percentages (2026)

Hover over a county to see its value. Click for details.
```{r}
make_leaflet_map(sf_data, "Active % (Jan 2026)", "Active %<br>(Jan 2026)")

make_leaflet_map(sf_data, "Two-Party Active % (Jan 2026)", "Two-Party Active %<br>(Jan 2026)")
```


#### Change in Active % from 2015 to 2026

Negative values indicate a percentage point decrease from 2015 to 2026. Hover over a county to see its value. Click for details.
```{r}
make_leaflet_map(sf_data, "Active % Change (2015-2026)", "Active % Change<br>(2015–2026)")

make_leaflet_map(sf_data, "Two-Party Active % Change (2015-2026)", "Two-Party Active %<br>Change (2015–2026)")
```


```{r}
# Prepare long_data for OJS: apply human-readable labels and keep only pct variables
plot_data <- long_data |>
    left_join(var_labels, by = "name") |>
    mutate(name = coalesce(label, name)) |>
    select(-label) |>
    filter(name %in% var_labels$label) |>
    select(county, year_month, year, month, name, value)

ojs_define(ojs_plot_data = plot_data)
```

```{ojs}
plot_data = transpose(ojs_plot_data)
```

```{ojs}
viewof selected_var = Inputs.select(
  [...new Set(plot_data.map(d => d.name))].sort(),
  { label: "Variable", value: "Active %" }
)
```

```{ojs}
all_counties = [...new Set(plot_data.map(d => d.county))].sort()
```

```{ojs}
viewof selected_counties = Inputs.select(all_counties, {
  label: "Counties",
  multiple: true,
  value: ["Polk", "Johnson", "Linn"]
})
```

```{ojs}
filtered_plot_data = plot_data
  .filter(d => d.name === selected_var && selected_counties.includes(d.county))
  .map(d => ({...d, date: new Date(d.year_month + "-01")}))
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.line(filtered_plot_data, {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "county"}),
    Plot.tip(filtered_plot_data, Plot.pointer({
      x: "date",
      y: "value",
      channels: {
        County: "county",
        Date: d => d.year_month,
        Value: d => (d.value * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"
      }
    }))
  ],
  x: { label: "Date" },
  y: { label: selected_var, tickFormat: "%" },
  color: { legend: true },
  width: 800
})
```
